data.narrative:
Agile Robots is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company seeking valuation at the $1.0B+ post-money mark. The comparable universe consists of eight private peers operating in robotics and adjacent automation sectors, supplemented by one public company (277810.KQ). Key private comparables include Exotec (Series D, $2.0B), Bedrock Robotics (Series B, $1.8B), Dexterity (Series B, $1.6B), and Hadrian (Series D, $1.6B).

Two valuation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier—typical for Series C advancement—to the last post-money valuation of $1.0B, yielding $1.7B. Peer-median analysis across six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median of $1.7B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. Both methods converge on identical point estimates, reinforcing consistency.

Triangulation across these two approaches supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $2.0B, with a median of $1.7B. The convergence of stage-progression and peer-median methodologies at $1.7B suggests reasonable internal validity. Primary uncertainties include the relative maturity and revenue trajectory of Agile Robots versus the peer set, as well as macroeconomic conditions affecting robotics-sector funding velocity. The tight methodological agreement mitigates model risk.
